These matching cloud responses preserve length, stop/flap, gemination and final-vowel differences. Minority-lect extensions are comparative proposals, with inheritance versus local transmission pending review; longer rain-cloud compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3582 gives Tamil naṭa, Malayalam naṭakka, Kannada naḍe/naḍi, Kodagu naḍa- and Tulu naḍapuni to walk. These complete southern survey naḍa/naḍi/naḍakk-/naḍap- forms preserve the stem and source inflection; the Kudiya naḍapu comparison follows intransitive Tulu naḍapuni, not Kannada causative naḍapu. Longer or opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5276 explicitly gives Tamil valiya strong/big, Malayalam valiya great, Kannada bal(u)/bolu bigness and Kodagu ballyë great. These southern survey valiya/baliya/belliya-type big adjectives extend that documented family, retaining ordinary adjective endings and source vowel/length notation. The right-hand sense of the current parent is only one sense: its primary article directly supports bigness. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
